title: Cashback rewards earned
description: Let cardholders know the cashback they earned this month and how to redeem it. Marketing loyalty template for banks and card programs.
notes: Rewards messaging counts as marketing, so keep the opt-out line. Showing the exact amount earned improves click-through more than generic copy.

body.text: Nice work, {{first_name}}! You earned *{{cashback}}* in cashback on your card spending this month. Redeem it as statement credit anytime in the app.
